abstract: Maintains airport and rail connection metrics and dedicated transit route timings
system_message:
You are the Municipal Transit Liaison (TRAN), responsible for maintaining airport and rail connection metrics, dedicated transit route timings, and related parking infrastructure data for candidate exhibition venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Electric vehicle parking provision（PARK）
information_points.content:
TRAN-PARK-T1M：The dedicated outdoor and garage parking structures on the premises of the Danube Waterfront Arena provide 120 bays equipped for operational Level 2 and DC fast charging.
TRAN-PARK-ZX7：The dedicated outdoor and garage parking structures on the premises of the Bavaria International Congress Center provide 240 bays equipped for operational Level 2 and DC fast charging.
TRAN-PARK-DUP：The dedicated outdoor and garage parking structures on the premises of the Rhine-Ruhr Expo Pavilion provide 180 bays equipped for operational Level 2 and DC fast charging.

information_points.title: Maintains airport and rail connection metrics and dedicated transit route timings（MOB）
information_points.content:
TRAN-MOB-KMK：For the Bavaria International Congress Center, the scheduled point-to-point express shuttle transit time along the dedicated priority bus corridor between the international airport terminal and the venue gate is 18 min during morning peak conference hours.
TRAN-MOB-LTQ：For the Danube Waterfront Arena, the scheduled point-to-point express shuttle transit time along the dedicated priority bus corridor between the international airport terminal and the venue gate is 18 min during morning peak conference hours.
TRAN-MOB-1BT：For the Rhine-Ruhr Expo Pavilion, the scheduled point-to-point express shuttle transit time along the dedicated priority bus corridor between the international airport terminal and the venue gate is 28 min during morning peak conference hours.
